prompt: Which report gives the map team a reason to correct a street color?
promptZh: 哪一份回報可構成地圖團隊更正街道顏色的理由？

options.text: A sample walker found a missing street name at noon.
options.zh: 抽樣人員中午發現缺少一個街名。
options.whyZh: 缺街名是標示問題，不是更正噪音顏色的依據。

options.text: One sample walker heard roadwork at eleven on a quiet street.
options.zh: 一位抽樣人員有一次十一點在安靜街道聽見施工。
options.whyZh: 只有單次觀察，並非多次抽樣都較吵。

options.text: Neighbors heard building work on several nights.
options.zh: 鄰居有好幾晚聽見施工。
options.whyZh: 夜間不在十點至十六點的抽樣時段。

options.text: Several sample walks at two in the afternoon found a once-quiet block noisier because of a building site.
options.zh: 好幾次下午兩點抽樣時，原本安靜的街段都因工地變吵。
options.whyZh: 同時符合抽樣時段、反覆出現及工地使原有路段變吵的條件。

explanationZh: 同時符合抽樣時段、反覆出現及工地使原有路段變吵的條件。
evidence: These are made between ten in the morning and four in the afternoon. | We do issue a correction if a building site has made a formerly quiet stretch noisy on several sample walks.

vocabulary.note: 按固定時段步行觀察街道。

difficultyRationale: 結合樣本時段與多次重複，不混淆改符號與改顏色。
